surface-card.$description: wee-dote card fill: raised #E4EDE5 on the sage ground.

ground.$description: Three-level ground in wee-dote: sage IS the page and the ground (ground < inset < raised). Added 2026-10-10.

usage: The page behind raised cards in a three-level layout
dont: Do not put muted text on wee-dote ground without verifying AAA: #3D3D3D gives 7.20:1 exactly.

raised.$description: Raised card on the sage ground, lightest surface in wee-dote. Added 2026-10-10.

text-secondary.$description: wee-dote secondary text. #3D3D3D: 7.20:1 on bg (AAA worst).

text-muted.$description: wee-dote muted text. Same value as text-secondary.

focus-ring.$description: Focus ring in wee-dote: ink #121212. Ochre-deep fails 3:1 on sage (2.38:1); ink gives 12.43:1 on bg and 15.65:1 on panel. Added 2026-10-10.

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-10-10: 12.43:1 on bg, 15.65:1 on panel. Non-text 3:1 passes everywhere.

accent-border.$description: wee-dote control-weight edge for a selected item.

border-faint.$description: wee-dote hairline card edge, decorative only.

border-strong.$description: wee-dote control border, 3:1+ on every surface (3.09:1 on bg worst).

danger-text.$description: wee-dote danger text: #9B1A14, darker than light.danger for AA on sage bg (5.46:1).

success-text.$description: wee-dote success text: #0E4D26, darker for AA on sage bg (6.61:1).

lane-a.$description: Lane-a fill in wee-dote: yellow #EBBB03. Ink 10.39:1 (AAA). Fills only.

dont: Fills only — text beside, not on

lane-b.$description: Lane-b fill in wee-dote: blue #0498D0. Ink 5.72:1, white 3.28:1 - both fail AAA. Fills only.

dont: Fills only — AAA fails both ways

lane-c.$description: Lane-c fill in wee-dote: pink #E5B3BF. Ink 10.29:1 (AAA). Fills only.

dont: Fills only — text beside, not on

lane-d.$description: Lane-d fill in wee-dote: red #E32923. Ink 4.11:1, white 4.56:1 - both fail AAA. Fills only.

dont: Fills only — AAA fails both ways

chat-surface-received.$description: Received chat bubble surface (wee-dote). Ink 16.8:1 (AAA) on #DDE6DD sage tint.

$description: wee-dote theme ([data-theme="wee-dote"], 2026-10-10, Elleta): overrides on top of semantic/light.json. Sage sardine-tin ground, raised card surface, lane colours for The Bar chat. Focus ring is ink (ochre-deep fails 3:1 on sage). Danger/success overridden darker for AA on sage. Everything not listed here is the light value.
